title: Beyoond the Horizon
description: A full-on fantasy adventure with exploration, magic, structures, and the convenience of Minecraft gameplay.
body:
✔️ Exploration of dimensions and floating islands (Aether, Oh_The_Biomes_You’ll_Go)
✔️ Random dungeons, new structures, and challenges to discover (DungeonCrawl, repurposed_structures)
✔️ Magic items, artifacts, and mysterious locations (jumpboat, balm, recall)
✔️ Minimalist map with terrain overview (Xaero’s Minimap)
✔️ Compact backpacks and convenient travel with teleportation (travelersbackpack, waystones, teleportcraft)
✔️ Easier navigation of items and recipes (JEI, Nature’s Compass, geckolib)
✔️ Interface additions and gameplay improvements (cloth-config, architectury, corgilib)
✔️ An optimal adventure for fans of exploration, RPGs, and improved game mechanics
